changes.original: English Español a black phone · before the item un teléfono negro My phone is black . · after is Mi teléfono es negro .
changes.replacement: Position English Español Before the item a black phone un teléfono negro After be My phone is black . Mi teléfono es negro .

changes.original: Use a or an with one. Two or more: use the plural.
changes.replacement: One Two or more a tomato two tomato es an apple two apple s

changes.original: No a or an . a rice → rice No plural -s .
changes.replacement: Not like this Like this a rice rice rices rice

changes.original: I → me · you → you he → him · she → her it → it · we → us they → them
changes.replacement: Subject I you he she it we they Object me you him her it us them

changes.original: After the verb: Max helps me . I help him . I help you .
changes.replacement: Max helps me . I help him . I help you .

changes.original: Enough and not enough go before the noun.
cheese enough tomatoes not enough → → enough cheese not enough tomatoes
changes.replacement: Not like this Like this cheese enough enough cheese tomatoes not enough not enough tomatoes

changes.original: Because: Why? I share them because I don't need them. So: result I have too many apples , so four apples are free. Use a comma before so .
changes.replacement: Reason Result I share them because I don't need them. I have too many apples , so four apples are free.

changes.original: For actions now : use am , is or are and a verb ending in -ing .
changes.replacement: Now

changes.original: I’m wearing a hat. She’s reading. They’re talking.
changes.replacement: I am wearing a hat. She is reading. They are talking.
changes.reason: Expose auxiliary agreement in complete parallel models, without a compressed rule paragraph.

changes.original: I usually wear black. Now, I ’m wearing blue.
changes.replacement: Usually Now I wear black. I am wearing blue.

changes.original: More than we need What we need The jacket is too big . The bag is big enough . too + adjective adjective + enough
changes.replacement: More than we need What we need We need more The jacket is too big . The bag is big enough . The bag isn’t big enough .

changes.original: Not what we need: The bag isn’t big enough .
It’s enough big. → It’s big enough .
changes.replacement: Not like this Like this It’s enough big. It’s big enough .

changes.original: Every + singular noun: every day / week / month / year every weeks → every week every a week → every week
changes.replacement: every day every week every month every year Not like this Like this every weeks every week every a week every week

changes.original: Start with the verb: Go straight. Goes straight.
changes.replacement: Not like this Like this Goes straight. Go straight.

changes.original: After can / can’t, use come , walk , go …
She can comes. → She can come . Do you can go? → Can you go?
changes.replacement: Not like this Like this She can comes. She can come . Do you can go? Can you go?
